name: Siquijor Island Marathon 2026
short_description: The Siquijor Island Marathon 2026 is a full-marathon event held in Siquijor, Philippines on September 26, 2026, with distances from 5 km to 42.195 km.
ai_summary: The Siquijor Island Marathon 2026 is a full-marathon event scheduled for September 26, 2026, on the island of Siquijor, Philippines. Runners can choose from four distances: 42.195 km, 21.1 km, 10 km, and 5 km, making it accessible to a range of fitness levels. The race offers a scenic island setting in Siquijor for those seeking a Philippine race destination.
pros: Multiple distance options (42.195 km, 21.1 km, 10 km, 5 km) suit different runner levels
Held in the scenic island location of Siquijor, Philippines
Clear event date already set for September 26, 2026
research_highlights: This is the inaugural edition of the Siquijor Island Marathon, described by organizers as part of a 'Run for Community & Education' initiative with no prior editions to draw participant history from.
Promotional material describes the course finishing near Cambugahay Falls, a waterfall spot on the island, positioned as a post-race cool-off attraction.
Race proceeds are directed toward supporting Siquijor's public school students with learning materials and classroom supplies, per the organizers.

Siquijor also hosts a separate, longer-running event on the island (Isla Del Fuego Marathon, held in early September in past years), so prospective travelers should confirm which specific race and date they are registering for, as listings for the Siquijor Island Marathon itself show some date inconsistencies (late June, and September 24-26 variously reported).
research_watchouts: As a first-time/inaugural event, there are no participant race reports, reviews, or running-community discussions available yet to verify course conditions, organization quality, heat management, or crowd support.

Listed event dates for this race vary across sources (June 6, September 24, and September 25, 2026 have all appeared in different listings), so registrants should verify the exact date directly with organizers before booking travel.

faqs.question: When is the Siquijor Island Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: The Siquijor Island Marathon 2026 is scheduled to take place on September 26, 2026. This date has been confirmed for the event, which will be held on the island of Siquijor in the Philippines, though further scheduling details beyond the date have not yet been provided.

faqs.question: What distances are offered at the Siquijor Island Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: The event offers four distance options for participants: a full marathon of 42.195 km, a half marathon of 21.1 km, a 10 km race, and a shorter 5 km race, allowing runners of varying experience and fitness levels to choose a suitable challenge.

faqs.question: Where is the Siquijor Island Marathon 2026 held?
faqs.answer: The Siquijor Island Marathon 2026 takes place on the island of Siquijor, located in the Philippines. The event's venue and city are both listed simply as Siquijor, making it a location-specific race for those looking to experience running on this particular Philippine island.
